verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway supports declarative, database-less deployment run locally via Docker without any Konnect (cloud) account, and configuration can be managed fully via decK/Admin API on localhost (kong-gh-4, kong-gh-7, kong-gh-20, kong-gh-10). However, the evidence also repeatedly pushes Konnect cloud sign-up as the default path (kong-gh-12, kong-docs-45/46), and there's no 'workspace/collections' concept for local project management as implied by the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a fully offline developer workspace/collections experience, confirmation that no telemetry/cloud touchpoints are required, and independent hands-on validation of offline-only usage.
